gui.rpperks.reason.admin_only: Granted and removed by the staff only
gui.rpperks.reason.conflict: Conflicts with %s§r. Give it up first
gui.rpperks.reason.no_points_refund: Giving this up takes back %s points — not enough
gui.rpperks.blocked_admin: The player is forbidden to take this perk
gui.rpperks.reason.blocked: The staff forbade you to take this perk
gui.rpperks.reason.selection_locked: The staff closed perk selection for you
perk.rpperks.survivor.name: §aHardy
perk.rpperks.tough.name: §aTough
perk.rpperks.tough.desc: Takes a hit: −20% damage to body parts, pain shock comes later, +1 armor toughness, less knockback.
perk.rpperks.strongman.name: §aStrongman
perk.rpperks.strongman.desc: Strength +3 at start (6), +10% melee damage for good.
perk.rpperks.tourist.name: §aTourist
perk.rpperks.tourist.desc: Handles heat and cold better, immunity 20% stronger.
perk.rpperks.organized.name: §aOrganized
perk.rpperks.lucky.name: §aLucky
perk.rpperks.lucky.desc: Trouble passes by: monsters sometimes go for others, lands well, tools don't wear, a heavy wound sometimes turns out moderate.
perk.rpperks.enduring.name: §aEnduring
perk.rpperks.enduring.desc: Catches breath fast: stamina recovery +20%, running and swimming 10% cheaper.
perk.rpperks.brave.name: §aBrave
perk.rpperks.brave.desc: Stress builds slower, hands shake less, pain shock comes later.
perk.rpperks.strong_willed.name: §aStrong-willed
perk.rpperks.strong_willed.desc: Sanity suffers less from horrors, suggestion and anomalies.
perk.rpperks.nerd_rage.name: §aNerd Rage
perk.rpperks.nerd_rage.desc: Below 20% health gets Strength I and Resistance I.
perk.rpperks.agile.name: §aAgile
perk.rpperks.agile.desc: Block and attack reach +1, wider minigame zones.
perk.rpperks.solar_powered.name: §aSolar Powered
perk.rpperks.solar_powered.desc: Outdoors in daylight: Speed I and stamina recovery +50%.
perk.rpperks.light_travel.name: §aLight Traveller
perk.rpperks.light_travel.desc: In light clothes (up to 6 armor points) running, jumping and climbing cost 15% less stamina.
perk.rpperks.alcoholic.name: §aIron Constitution
perk.rpperks.alcoholic.desc: Chemicals barely work on this body: drunk slower, nicotine and coffee are weaker, so are medicines and anaesthesia (the doctor needs a bigger dose). Binges hurt the liver less. Neither causes nor prevents addiction.
perk.rpperks.smoker.name: §cSmoker
perk.rpperks.smoker.desc: Starts as a smoker: nicotine addiction. Without cigarettes — withdrawal: irritable, craving a smoke. Can quit: without smoking the craving fades in a few RP days, but relapse is easier later. The cough can be heard nearby.
perk.rpperks.soldier.name: §aTrained Soldier
perk.rpperks.soldier.desc: Weapons at a good soldier's level: short and long arms 5, heavy 3, explosives 2, melee 3. Basic first aid (Medicine 2).
perk.rpperks.medic.name: §aAnastasia
perk.rpperks.medic.desc: Medicine 8: complex procedures, full use of drugs, instruments and equipment.
perk.rpperks.melee_fighter.name: §aMelee Fighter
perk.rpperks.melee_fighter.desc: Melee 5: hits harder and faster with any melee weapon and bare hands, tires less in combat.
perk.rpperks.builder.name: §aRogalev
perk.rpperks.builder.desc: Basic, non-professional engineering and construction skills (RP). Mining blocks is less tiring.
perk.rpperks.gunner.name: §aFirearms Course
perk.rpperks.explosives.name: §aExplosives
perk.rpperks.explosives.desc: Explosives 5, heavy arms 1. Making, defusing and using explosive devices.
perk.rpperks.technician.name: §aDenton
perk.rpperks.technician.desc: Operates complex equipment and machinery, limited repairs (RP).
perk.rpperks.hacker.name: §aHacking
perk.rpperks.hacker.desc: Only they can pick locks. +1 attempt when hacking a PDA, more time when decrypting notes.
perk.rpperks.sailor.name: §aSeafarer
perk.rpperks.sailor.desc: Knows how to fish, faster swimming, swimming is less tiring.
perk.rpperks.tailor.name: §aTailoring
perk.rpperks.farmer.name: §aFarmer
perk.rpperks.farmer.desc: Can farm, forage and identify wild plants (RP).
perk.rpperks.cook.name: §aCook
perk.rpperks.cook.desc: Cooks complex dishes and butchers carcasses (RP).
perk.rpperks.driver.name: §aDriver
perk.rpperks.pilot.name: §aPinpinych
perk.rpperks.first_aid.name: §aFirst Aid Course
perk.rpperks.first_aid.desc: Medicine 3: full first aid, basic handling of medical items.
perk.rpperks.fragile.name: §cFragile
perk.rpperks.fragile.desc: +20% damage to body parts, bones break easier, pain shock comes sooner, more knockback.
perk.rpperks.disorganized.name: §cDisorganized
perk.rpperks.diabetic.name: §cDiabetic
perk.rpperks.diabetic.desc: Needs insulin daily: blood sugar must be kept normal.
perk.rpperks.anorexic.name: §cAnorexic
perk.rpperks.anorexic.desc: Smaller stomach, sudden refusals to eat.
perk.rpperks.weakling.name: §cShort-winded
perk.rpperks.weakling.desc: Slow to catch breath: stamina recovery −20%, running and swimming 10% dearer.
perk.rpperks.homebody.name: §cHomebody
perk.rpperks.homebody.desc: Handles heat and cold worse, immunity 20% weaker.
perk.rpperks.unlucky.name: §cUnlucky
perk.rpperks.unlucky.desc: Trouble finds you: monsters prefer you, ankles twist, tools slip.
perk.rpperks.turtle.name: §cSlowpoke
perk.rpperks.wimp.name: §cFeeble
perk.rpperks.wimp.desc: Strength −3 at start (0), −10% melee damage and knockback for good.
perk.rpperks.suggestible.name: §cSuggestible
perk.rpperks.suggestible.desc: Sanity suffers more from horrors, suggestion and anomalies.
perk.rpperks.caffeine_addiction.name: §cCaffeine Addict
perk.rpperks.caffeine_addiction.desc: Starts addicted to caffeine. A day without coffee — withdrawal: headache, slower walking, weaker blows, slower stamina recovery, faster tiredness. Coffee ends it. Without coffee the addiction fades in a few RP days, but it's easier to fall back.
perk.rpperks.coward.name: §cCoward
perk.rpperks.coward.desc: Stress builds faster, hands shake more, pain shock comes sooner.
perk.rpperks.clumsy.name: §cClumsy
perk.rpperks.clumsy.desc: Sometimes drops the held item, firearms −1 level, narrower minigame zones.
perk.rpperks.technophobe.name: §cTechnophobe
perk.rpperks.technophobe.desc: Fears complex tech: can't hack PDAs, encrypt or decrypt notes, retune a radio; card readers take a few swipes.
perk.rpperks.landlubber.name: §cLandlubber
perk.rpperks.landlubber.desc: Can't swim: walks on the bottom, can't surface.
perk.rpperks.teetotaler.name: §cTeetotaler
perk.rpperks.admin.name: §dAdmin
perk.rpperks.admin.desc: Removes all restrictions and restores vanilla stats; stamina isn't spent. Other perks are suspended.
perk.rpperks.cannibal.name: §cCannibal
perk.rpperks.cannibal.desc: Human flesh is ordinary food to them: no sanity hit, vomiting or disease.
perk.rpperks.basic_training.name: §aBasic training
perk.rpperks.basic_training.desc: Short and long arms 2, melee 1, medicine 1.
perk.rpperks.pacifist.name: §cPacifist
perk.rpperks.pacifist.desc: Doesn't fight people: much less damage to humans, combat skills at most 1 and grow 10 times slower; Medicine and Cooking 25% faster.
gui.rpperks.skills.growth_off: Skill growth is off on this server: levels come from perks and the GM.
gui.rpperks.skills.hint: Skills 0–10: 5 is average, 10 is master. They grow with practice; perks set a minimum.
skill.rpperks.medicine.desc: Treating people. Affects: speed and precision of procedures, error chance, what an exam reveals, access to complex drugs and surgery. Grows: by treating others.
skill.rpperks.cooking.desc: Cooking. Affects: dish quality, burn chance, how precisely food composition is shown. Grows: by cooking; complex dishes give more, repeats less.
skill.rpperks.short_arms.desc: Pistols and SMGs. Affects: spread, recoil, reload and aiming time. Grows: by shooting and hitting.
skill.rpperks.long_arms.desc: Rifles and shotguns. Affects: spread, recoil, reload and aiming time. Grows: by shooting and hitting.
skill.rpperks.heavy_arms.desc: Machine guns, sniper rifles, launchers. Affects: spread, recoil (Strength helps hold it), reload and aiming time. Grows: by shooting and hitting.
skill.rpperks.explosives.desc: Explosive weapons. Affects: blast power and radius of your weapons. Grows: by firing launchers.
skill.rpperks.melee.desc: Any melee weapon and bare hands. Affects: damage and attack speed. Grows: by hitting living targets.
skill.rpperks.strength.desc: Physical strength. Each level above normal (3): melee damage and attack speed, knockback, less heavy-weapon recoil, easier carrying of the wounded. Grows from hits, mining, workouts. Drops from poor food, illness, being underweight.
skill.rpperks.fitness.desc: Fitness: physical shape. Each level above normal (3): bigger stamina pool and faster recovery, cheaper running, higher speed; from 9 — step up a block. Grows from running, swimming, workouts. Drops from poor food, illness, weight out of norm.
message.rpperks.skill_down: Skill «%s» dropped to %s — the body weakens (food, illness)
perk.rpperks.gourmet.name: §aGourmet
perk.rpperks.gourmet.desc: Same food gets boring faster, good food pleases more.
perk.rpperks.fast_metabolism.name: §aFast Metabolism
perk.rpperks.fast_metabolism.desc: Burns 15% more calories: hard to get fat, but needs more food.
perk.rpperks.dietitian.name: §aDietitian
perk.rpperks.dietitian.desc: Sees exact food composition and what-to-eat hints, numbers in the Nutrition window.
perk.rpperks.field_cook.name: §aField Cook
perk.rpperks.field_cook.desc: Cooks on a campfire or in a smoker as if 2 Cooking levels higher.
perk.rpperks.kitchen_nightmare.name: §cKitchen Nightmare
perk.rpperks.kitchen_nightmare.desc: Cooks 3 Cooking levels worse, burns food more often.
perk.rpperks.slow_metabolism.name: §cSlow Metabolism
perk.rpperks.slow_metabolism.desc: Burns 15% fewer calories: needs less food, gets fat easily.
gui.rpperks.skills.admin_hint: −/+ in a row — a level, buttons below — 10 %% of a level. The GM adds or removes on top of the trained level; the skill then grows and drops on its own.
commands.rpperks.help.admin: admin window for a player (no name — your own)
perk.rpperks.athletic.name: §aAthletic
perk.rpperks.fit.name: §aFit
perk.rpperks.strong.name: §aStrong
perk.rpperks.second_wind.name: §aSecond Wind
perk.rpperks.second_wind.desc: Once an hour, when stamina hits zero, half of it comes back.
perk.rpperks.quick_rest.name: §aQuick Rest
perk.rpperks.quick_rest.desc: Recovers stamina twice as fast while sitting.
perk.rpperks.gym_lover.name: §aGym Lover
perk.rpperks.gym_lover.desc: Workouts 50% more useful, muscles recover twice as fast.
perk.rpperks.iron_stomach.name: §aIron Stomach
perk.rpperks.iron_stomach.desc: Food poisoning half as often, overeating hits later.
perk.rpperks.clean.name: §aClean Freak
perk.rpperks.clean.desc: Washes hands and food: gets food poisoning half as often, and their dishes poison others half as often.
perk.rpperks.light_eater.name: §aLight Eater
perk.rpperks.light_eater.desc: Hunger is slower, but the stomach is smaller.
perk.rpperks.low_thirst.name: §aLow Thirst
perk.rpperks.fleet.name: §aFleet-footed
perk.rpperks.fast_learner.name: §aFast Learner
perk.rpperks.fast_learner.desc: +20% XP for all skills except Strength and Fitness.
perk.rpperks.quick_worker.name: §aQuick Worker
perk.rpperks.puny.name: §cPuny
perk.rpperks.out_of_shape.name: §cOut of Shape
perk.rpperks.weak.name: §cWeak
perk.rpperks.emaciated.name: §cEmaciated
perk.rpperks.emaciated.desc: Starts below normal weight: skipped meals burn muscle, feels cold. Strength and Fitness capped at 5 while underweight.
perk.rpperks.overweight.name: §cOverweight
perk.rpperks.overweight.desc: Starts above normal weight. Fitness capped at 6 while overweight.
perk.rpperks.obese.name: §cObese
perk.rpperks.obese.desc: Starts obese: less stamina, higher blood pressure, harder exercise. Fitness capped at 4 until slimmer.
perk.rpperks.asthmatic.name: §cAsthmatic
perk.rpperks.asthmatic.desc: Oxygen drops while running, attacks under heavy load, needs an inhaler.
perk.rpperks.delicate.name: §cDelicate
perk.rpperks.amputee.name: §cAmputee
perk.rpperks.amputee.desc: Starts without an arm or a leg, prosthesis optional.
perk.rpperks.weak_stomach.name: §cWeak Stomach
perk.rpperks.weak_stomach.desc: Gets food poisoning more often, overeating hits sooner.
perk.rpperks.big_eater.name: §cBig Eater
perk.rpperks.big_eater.desc: Hunger is faster, but the stomach is bigger.
perk.rpperks.high_thirst.name: §cHigh Thirst
perk.rpperks.bad_teeth.name: §cBad Teeth
perk.rpperks.clumsy_runner.name: §cClumsy Runner
perk.rpperks.clumsy_runner.desc: Sometimes trips while running, may sprain an ankle.
perk.rpperks.slow_learner.name: §cSlow Learner
perk.rpperks.slow_learner.desc: −20% XP for all skills except Strength and Fitness.
perk.rpperks.slow_worker.name: §cSlow Worker
perk.rpperks.illiterate.name: §cIlliterate
perk.rpperks.illiterate.desc: Can't read: PDA messages look like scribbles.
perk.rpperks.hemophobic.name: §cHemophobic
perk.rpperks.hemophobic.desc: Panics at the sight of blood: treatment with blood is slower, minigames harder.
perk.rpperks.alcohol_addict.name: §cAlcoholic
perk.rpperks.alcohol_addict.desc: Starts addicted to alcohol. An RP day without a drink — withdrawal: tremor, sweating, nausea, pain, sometimes seizures (a doctor's sedative helps). After a few days only the craving remains. Sobriety cures it in a week or so, but the perk stays: relapse is easier, it brings the habit right back, and heavy stress brings the urge to drink.
perk.rpperks.sun_sensitive.name: §cSun Sensitive
perk.rpperks.sun_sensitive.desc: Outdoors in daylight without headwear: weakness and headache.
gui.rpperks.profile.hint: Body profile: sex, age, height. All mods use it for blood volume, weight norms and how age affects stamina, healing and Strength/Fitness growth.
gui.rpperks.reason.mod_missing: Needs a mod the server doesn't have
message.rpperks.skill_down_weight: Skill «%s» dropped to %s — weight holds it back
message.rpperks.migrated_2: Traits were updated (RP Perks 2.0). Old versions removed, points refunded (%s). Pick again: /rpperks
gui.rpperks.profile.gm_only: Only a GM can change the profile.
gui.rpperks.profile.first: First, the character profile. It is saved once, then traits open.
gui.rpperks.profile.admin_hint: The player's profile. Change sex, age or height and save.
gui.rpperks.taste.hint: Tastes — a kind of food or a way of cooking. Optional, but choosing a favourite means choosing a disliked one too. The favourite never gets boring and cheers you up, the disliked gets boring twice as fast. You choose once; after that only a GM can change it.
perk.rpperks.exotic_game.name: §bKnowledge: game
perk.rpperks.exotic_game.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks game properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.exotic_seafood.name: §bKnowledge: shellfish
perk.rpperks.exotic_seafood.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks shellfish properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.exotic_fugu.name: §bKnowledge: pufferfish (fugu)
perk.rpperks.exotic_fugu.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks pufferfish (fugu) properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.exotic_deep_sea.name: §bKnowledge: deep-sea fish
perk.rpperks.exotic_deep_sea.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks deep-sea fish properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.exotic_insects.name: §bKnowledge: insects
perk.rpperks.exotic_insects.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks insects properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.exotic_offal.name: §bKnowledge: offal
perk.rpperks.exotic_offal.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks offal properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.exotic_mushrooms.name: §bKnowledge: wild mushrooms
perk.rpperks.exotic_mushrooms.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks wild mushrooms properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.exotic_other_worlds.name: §bKnowledge: Nether and End
perk.rpperks.exotic_other_worlds.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks Nether and End properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.exotic_monsters.name: §bKnowledge: monsters and mutants
perk.rpperks.exotic_monsters.desc: Studied the journal or notes: cooks monsters and mutants properly. Without it such dishes come out worse and can be dangerous.
perk.rpperks.vintner.name: §aVintner
perk.rpperks.vintner.desc: Distils spirits, brews beer, makes wine, cider and mead. Without it brewing and wine stations do not obey.
perk.rpperks.preserver.name: §aPreserver
perk.rpperks.preserver.desc: Cans, smokes, salts and dries food. Without it preserves do not work out.
perk.rpperks.seafood_allergy.name: §cShellfish allergy
perk.rpperks.seafood_allergy.desc: Mussels, squid, lobster, shrimp — even well cooked — cause a rash, swelling and shortness of breath.
perk.rpperks.unfussy.name: §aUnfussy
perk.rpperks.unfussy.desc: Sleeps on anything as well as in a bed; never goes numb; nightmares do not depend on the place.
perk.rpperks.deep_sleeper.name: §aDeep Sleeper
perk.rpperks.deep_sleeper.desc: Voices and shots do not wake him, explosions only closer than 8 blocks. Hits, Shift and the alarm do.
perk.rpperks.short_sleeper.name: §aShort Sleeper
perk.rpperks.tireless.name: §aTireless
perk.rpperks.tireless.desc: Sleep deprivation stages come twice as late.
perk.rpperks.early_bird.name: §aEarly Bird
perk.rpperks.early_bird.desc: Alertness drains slower in the morning (6:00–12:00), faster after 22:00.
perk.rpperks.night_owl.name: §aNight Owl
perk.rpperks.night_owl.desc: Alertness drains slower in the evening and at night (18:00–2:00), faster in the morning.
perk.rpperks.insomnia.name: §cInsomnia
perk.rpperks.insomnia.desc: Sleeps slower, sometimes cannot fall asleep, cannot sleep for 5 minutes after waking.
perk.rpperks.light_sleeper.name: §cLight Sleeper
perk.rpperks.light_sleeper.desc: Even a whisper wakes him; voices from 8 blocks, shots from 24.
perk.rpperks.sleepyhead.name: §cSleepyhead
perk.rpperks.sleepyhead.desc: Alertness drains faster, but sleeps better sitting, lying or on a seat.
perk.rpperks.nightmares.name: §cNightmares
perk.rpperks.heavy_waking.name: §cHeavy Waking
perk.rpperks.heavy_waking.desc: Sluggish for a minute after waking: walks slower, cannot sprint.
perk.rpperks.snorer.name: §cSnorer
perk.rpperks.snorer.desc: Snores in his sleep — audible within 8 blocks, wakes light sleepers nearby.
gui.rpperks.reason.no_points_reset: The balance would go %s below zero after a reset — ask a GM
commands.rpperks.help.audit: Perks that currently lack a mod with their mechanics
commands.rpperks.audit.ok: §aEvery available perk has mechanics or is deliberately RP-only.
